# Library ingestion checklist

- Supported extensions and MIME/content validation
- Root ownership and resolved-path containment
- Series grouping and chapter identity
- Natural ordering and case handling
- Page count and zero-page behavior
- Corrupt, partial, missing, and inaccessible inputs
- Repeat-scan idempotency
- Safe deletion reconciliation scope
- Cover/page cache creation and cleanup
- File, archive, image, memory, and time limits
- Synthetic fixtures and temporary database cleanup
